title: New agent
models_failed: Couldn't load the model list. You can still start with the default model.
launchers_failed: Couldn't read this computer's models. You can still start with its default model.
project_document_no_versions: This document has no approved versions.
project_document_no_documents: This project has no approved documents.
project_document_catalog_unavailable: The document list is unavailable. Enter a document ID to load its latest approved revision.
project_document_error_access: Couldn't access the approved document. Check your project access token.
project_document_error_missing: Couldn't find an approved revision. Check the project and document IDs.
project_document_error_invalid: Couldn't verify the approved document. Check the IDs and reload the revision.
project_document_error_unavailable: Couldn't load the approved document. Check the connection and try again.
project_document_unsupported: This start can't use the attached document. Switch to a supported local Claude Code or Codex launcher, or remove the document.
project_document_changed_connection: The connection changed. Remove the attached document and reload it on this connection.
prompt_placeholder_keys: What should it do… ({keys} to start)
attach_hint: Paste or drop images and files · sent in the background after start
permission_mode_hint: You can change the mode in the conversation later; Full access can only be picked when starting.
provider_mode_hint: This agent uses its own approval settings unless you pick Full access. You can switch in the conversation later.
no_computer_body: An agent runs on one of your computers, so there is nothing to pick here yet. Add one first.
worktree_hint: A branch and a checkout of its own: the agent changes code there, and this folder stays as it is.
blocked_terminal_body: Persona found “{name}” in this computer's login shell, but the shell new terminal tabs run doesn't have it: another shell, a container, or a startup file that stops early. New agents start in those tabs.
blocked_terminal_fix_rc: Define it in a startup file the terminal's shell reads (for bash, ~/.bashrc), then start again.
blocked_terminal_fix_provider: Or add it to Persona as a model provider: those work in any terminal.
blocked_terminal_clears: A start with it that works clears this; otherwise it clears by itself after 6 hours.
blocked_other_body: Its latest check on this computer failed, and automatic repair didn't fix it.
blocked_other_fix: Fix its key, gateway or CLI on that computer, or pick another launcher.
blocked_other_clears: A check or start with it that works clears this.
preset_left_out: Not applied here: {what}. The launcher's or model's own setting runs.
carry_dropped: {name} can’t run on {computer}, so its default is used.
opens_orca_chat: Opens as {name}: this computer starts new Agents as Orca chats.
opens_orca_chat_own: Opens as {name}, with Orca’s own model: this computer starts new Agents as Orca chats.
runs_hint: Start this task {count} times, each in a worktree of its own, and compare the results.
desktop_unavailable: The {app} desktop launcher is unavailable on this computer. Choose another launcher to continue.
desktop_project_detached: The original desktop project is no longer selected.
